name: Cementir Holding N.V.
summary: Cementir Holding N.V., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the building materials sector in Italy, Nordic and Baltic, Belgium, North America, Turkiye, Egypt, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Cement, Ready-Mixed Concrete, Aggregates, Waste, and Other segments.
